title: feat(spec,service-knowledge)!: knowledge_source is a governed metadata type with its loader, its registry and two authoring guards
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgHittdG1nUD4Ne4ozfqAXgk)_

Fixes #37304

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: follow-up #37310

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：知识源成为一种正式的应用配置，可以随应用一起发布，也可以在 Studio 里新建和修改；保存后平台自动建立、更新或清除对应的检索索引。旧写法升级时会被明确拒绝，迁移命令会列出每一处要改的地方。
- 为什么做：属于“知识检索平台化”专题，让应用写一份知识源配置就有可用的检索，并且谁能建知识源、能索引哪些数据都有人管。
- 出错会怎样：只影响用到知识检索的应用。旧配置没迁移时会报出要改的位置，不会悄悄丢数据或建错索引；新增的“管理知识源”权限默认只有平台管理员有；回退本改动即可恢复原状。
- 要你做什么：批准一次。这是一次不兼容的协议收紧，改了两份对外技能文件（各一两行），改动量也超过三千行，按规则要你批准后才能合并。

## What changes

**New metadata type: `knowledge_source`.** Registered in the metadata type registry with the one schema `KnowledgeSourceSchema`; a stack carries its sources in the new top-level collection `knowledgeSources` (`*.knowledge-source.ts` or `.yml`). An item can be created and changed at run time (Studio, MCP) and takes no environment overlay. Studio's menu lists the type under AI, and ADR-0084's type table carries its row.

**New platform capability: `manage_knowledge_sources`.** Platform administrators hold it by default. Nothing else grants it.

- **The schema is strict.** An undeclared key is refused. `id` becomes `name`, `source.contentFields` becomes `source.content`, a non-empty list of field names; `'*'` is refused with the instruction to list the fields, and an empty-string member is refused too (it names no field). `embedding`, `vectorStore`, `adapterConfig`, `refresh.cron` and the `file` / `http` source kinds are retired with their ADR-0087 entries (three conversions, six retired keys, six retired defs, four semantic entries on protocol 19). `os migrate meta --from 18` lists every edit and `--write` applies the ones it can prove.
- **The loader** (`service-knowledge`, `knowledge-source-loader.ts`). `KnowledgeServicePlugin` reads the published items when it starts and follows the type while it runs: an added source is registered and built when a build is due; a changed one is registered again (a changed `where` or `metadataFields` rebuilds inside the generation, a changed `content` or `split` builds a new one); a removed one is unregistered and its index dropped. The reap guard's object set follows the sources.
- **The registry** (`knowledge-source-registry.ts`), under the maintainer's rulings on this card (record 7192063608, forks 6 and 4d, both A). A source is held by `(package, name)`. A source registered in code belongs to no package; it shares one slot with an environment-authored item of the same name, and the second of the two to arrive is refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, naming both doors. A package's source of the same name is a second source. Code names a source by its face: the bare name for the package-less one, `NAMESPACE-NAME` for a package's; a bare name several sources answer to is refused `409`, naming the candidates. `search` hits carry the face as `sourceId`. No `IKnowledgeService` signature changes for addressing.
- **`IKnowledgeAdapter.dropSource?(ctx)`**, implemented by `knowledge-memory`, `knowledge-pgvector` and `knowledge-turso`; the contract suite (`@objectstack/service-knowledge/testing`) takes `implements.dropSource`. An adapter reads the source's index key from `ctx.source.name` (it was `ctx.source.id`): the bare name for a package-less source, so an existing index is found under the same key and nothing is rebuilt.
- **Guard one: the capability.** A write of a `knowledge_source` through `/meta` (REST and the dispatcher: save, publish, rollback, delete) and through the MCP draft door needs `manage_knowledge_sources` beside `manage_metadata`: `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` naming the capability, `401` for an anonymous caller. It is one row in the existing per-type table `META_TYPE_WRITE_CAPABILITIES` (`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`), so the three doors that already ask that table ask it for this type too. The package doors ask it as well (maintainer's ruling A, record 7207325373 on #37304): each of the twelve doors that write an existing package (enable, disable, publish, publish-drafts, discard-drafts, the commit revert, rollback, revert, adopt-orphans, duplicate, the manifest update, delete) refuses a caller without the capability `403` when the package holds a knowledge source: an item, a pending draft, or, for the commit revert and the rollback, a commit that touched one. A package that holds none is written as before; a holding that cannot be read refuses `503`. Two doors are not asked, see Acceptance notes.
- **Guard two: source admission at save.** The same doors save a source only when its author may themselves search what it would index: an object of a disabled package, an object the API does not serve for `search`, a system object without `enable.aiReadable`, or a field the author may not query refuses the save `403`, naming the object or the field; a verdict that cannot be reached refuses `503`. The fields a source's `where` reads are judged with the fields it serves, at save and at search. A knowledge service that is registered and cannot be resolved refuses the save `503` at every door (REST, the dispatcher, MCP). The duplicate door admits each knowledge source it would copy for the caller before anything is copied, and refuses the whole copy when one is refused. Over MCP the human is judged.
- **The push door leaves.** `IKnowledgeService.indexDocument` and `deleteDocument` are removed with the `file` / `http` branches that served them.
- **Removed exports**, twelve names from `@objectstack/spec/ai`. The `embedding` module: `EmbeddingModelSchema`, `VectorStoreSchema`, `VectorStoreProviderSchema` and the types `EmbeddingModel`, `VectorStore`, `VectorStoreProvider` (the knowledge source was their only composer). The retired source kinds: `FileKnowledgeSourceSchema`, `HttpKnowledgeSourceSchema`, `KnowledgeSourceKindSchema` and the types `FileKnowledgeSource`, `HttpKnowledgeSource`, `KnowledgeSourceKind`. The changeset lists the same twelve.
- **Boot notice** (`packages/objectql`). A deployment that holds `knowledge_source` items and mounts no knowledge service says so once at boot, at warn, naming the items; it is not a boot refusal.
- **CLI.** `os knowledge status` prints the package that holds a source and no longer a source kind.
- **Showcase.** `examples/app-showcase` ships `showcase_task_notes` (object `showcase_task`, adapter `memory`) and mounts the knowledge service and the memory store.
- **Docs.** `content/docs/protocol/knowledge.mdx` and `content/docs/ai/knowledge-rag.mdx` describe the type, the loader, who may author a source, and one name per source; the generated references follow.
- **Skills (Tier H), enumeration row only**, under ruling A on #32584: `knowledgeSources` joins the top-level key list in `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md`. `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`'s compiled `supportKb` example changes two keys (`id` to `name`, `contentFields` to `content`) because the old spelling is now refused at parse. Teaching the type (prose, tables, evals) rides #37310.
- **One ceiling, raised by the row's measured delta and by no more** (`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`): `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` was at zero headroom (24603 priced bytes, 6151 tokens, after #37442's row); the `knowledgeSources` row adds 20 bytes, so the priced text is 24623 bytes, 6156 tokens, and the ceiling moves 6151 to 6156, pinned at the measurement. Nothing else in the file is cut and nothing rides along. `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` stays at 6799 tokens under its ceiling of 6801.
- **The two rulings the raise path names**, quoted:
  - Ruling A on #32584 (record 6819475461): "a product PR that adds an authorable `defineStack()` top-level key, or a live member of a schema symbol bound to a registered exhaustive skills section, carries the matching skills enumeration row in the same PR. Only that row; prose, examples and evals still go to the skills sub-card."
  - #32673 letter A (record 6840575378): "a PR that adds a metadata key and, under ruling A on #32584, carries the matching enumeration row in a published skill may raise that skill file's token cap by the row's measured delta, and by no more. The PR body cites ruling A and this ruling. Nothing else in the file is cut to make room, and no wider raise rides along."

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/ai/knowledge-source.test.ts`: the strict schema, `'*'` refused, an empty-string member refused (and `minLength: 1` in the JSON Schema), every retired key answered with its prescription.
- `packages/services/service-knowledge/src/__tests__/knowledge-source-registry.test.ts` (new): the slot rules above, both orders of arrival at each door, face resolution and the `409` with its candidates.
- `.../knowledge-source-loader.test.ts` (new): boot read, add, change (each of the two rebuild arms), remove with `dropSource`, an adapter without `dropSource`, the reap guard following the sources.
- `.../knowledge-source-admission.test.ts`: each refusal of guard two and its fail-closed `503`; the fields `where` reads (keys, `$and` / `$or` / `$not`, `{ $field }` comparands) judged at save and at search.
- The adapter contract suite with `dropSource: true` in `knowledge-memory` and `knowledge-turso`; `knowledge-pgvector` declares it in `contract.live-postgres.test.ts` (see Remaining).
- `packages/rest/src/meta-type-write-capability.test.ts`: every write shape of a `knowledge_source` for a caller with `manage_metadata` alone, with `manage_platform_settings`, and with a record grant: `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, store unchanged, no protocol call; a holder of both saves, publishes, rolls back and resets; the capability without `manage_metadata` is refused by the door's own admission.
- `packages/rest/src/meta-write-door-capability-enumeration.test.ts`, `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-save-capability-gate.test.ts`, `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-authoring.test.ts`: guard two at REST, the dispatcher and the MCP save door (the human is judged); on a real kernel, a knowledge service whose factory throws answers `503` at the dispatcher and at MCP, and one never registered is not asked.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-type-write-capability-parity.test.ts`: REST and the dispatcher answer the same for the new row.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-knowledge-source-gate.test.ts` (new): each of the twelve package doors refuses a `manage_metadata`-only caller when the package holds a source (item or draft) and the writer never runs; a holder goes on with no listing read; a package with none answers as before; a listing that throws refuses `503`; the engine's own call is not asked; the commit revert and the rollback read the timeline; the duplicate door's admission of each copied source; a host with no metadata store holds none; the install door and the ensure-customization door are not asked.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-ensure-customization.test.ts`: a base that holds a knowledge source (a registered item and a stored row) gets a pair that holds none, and the door writes one manifest and no row.
- `packages/objectql/src/knowledge-source-unserved.test.ts` (new): the boot notice.
- `packages/metadata-core/src/knowledge-source-save-admission.test.ts` (new): the admission seam.

## Acceptance notes

- **Governed (Tier H) and over 3000 changed lines**: draft until the maintainer's approval. The diff touches `skills/**` and declares a narrowing.
- **Rulings this PR implements**: record 7192063608 on #37304 (forks 6 and 4d, both A); earlier on the same card Q1 = B (the type sits in ADR-0150's bucket 3) and Q2 = B (`manage_knowledge_sources` beside `manage_metadata`, platform administrators only); and ruling A of 2026-11-27 (record 7207325373): every write door of an existing package asks the capability when the package holds a knowledge source, and install stays unasked. The ADR-0150 rows ride #37545. One ADR line is edited here, with the zone's approval (claim comment 7203310811 on #37304, amended by 7204020473): ADR-0084's type table gains the `knowledge_source` row its item 6 prescribes for a type registered after the ruling (AI, `ai`, 5, 高级), spelled as the `ai_context` row is. Nothing else under `docs/adr/**` changes.
- **The loader's signal** is `protocol.onMetadataMutation` (a save, a publish, a delete, a revert) plus the `metadata:reloaded` hook (a package published, installed or removed, a dev reload), not `metadataService.subscribe`. After either it reads the published set again and reconciles, so a missed event is repaired by the next one.
- **Guard two is not asked where no knowledge service is mounted** (there is nothing to ask, and the item is inert there), nor for a system write.
- **Two package doors are not asked the new capability (limits).** The install door (`POST /packages`): a package's source arrives by that door's own admission, as the ruling leaves it. The ensure-customization door (`POST /packages/:id/ensure-customization`): it writes nothing of the base and creates an empty pair, so it creates, changes and removes no knowledge source; the seat confirmed this reading on the condition that the pair holds no source, which `packages-ensure-customization.test.ts` pins.
- **The package gate reads before it answers.** For a caller without the capability the twelve doors read the package's drafts and items (and its commits, for the two timeline verbs) before the door's own request checks. A host with no metadata store at all (the table was never created, or the engine holds no `sys_metadata` object) reads as holding none, by the same rule the protocol's overlay reads use; any other failed read refuses `503`.
- **The read-side author exemption** stays keyed on `manage_metadata`.
- **A bare name two sources answer to** is refused `409` at the call that names it (`resolveSourceRef`), listing the candidates; both sources register. Where the host cannot place a package's namespace, the package's face is its bare name, and that name answers `409` for both sources until the package is placed.
- **The four narrowings the ADR-0150 addendum asks this card to declare, each counted on this tree**: the install refusal inside a namespace (two packages of one namespace holding a source of one name): 0. The name grammar (a source whose name the grammar refuses): 0. The `409` for a bare name two packages hold: 0. The package-less row under a name a package holds: 0. The tree holds one knowledge source, `showcase_task_notes` (`examples/app-showcase/src/ai/task-notes.knowledge-source.ts`), and no first-party code registers one through the plugin door.
- **`KnowledgeIndexStatusEntry.kind` is removed** with the source kinds; `packageId` is added.
- **One ADR-0087 marker.** The gate allows exactly one marker per breaking changeset, so the changeset carries `registered …` and names `indexDocument` / `deleteDocument` in prose: they are runtime-interface members with no metadata form, and the compiler reports each call (`TS2339`).
- **The boot notice adds one boot read** of `knowledge_source` rows on a kernel that does not hydrate from its database; it registers nothing (`plugin.integration.test.ts` pins the permitted reads and now names this one).
- **pgvector `dropSource` and a concurrent build in another process**: the drop retires the active and the building generation in one transaction but does not hold the builder lock across it, so a build already running in another process could still write its generation afterwards. Not changed here; it is a candidate follow-up.
- **#37479 (unregistered adapter) is not folded in.** The loader runs after publish, so it is not a refusal point for publish; #37442 adds the coded refusal for an unmounted adapter.
- **The showcase mounts the two plugins by hand** rather than declaring `requires: ['knowledge']` (#37442): the token mounts a libSQL or pgvector store, which needs a configured embedder, and the demo runs on the in-memory store with none. A host that mounts the service itself keeps its own, as #37442 specifies.
- **Merged with `main` three times** (no rebase). The first merge (at `45ed022b`) followed #37442, #37570 and #37578: four textual conflicts (the migration registry template, the CLI knowledge test fixture, the pgvector adapter's search refusal, the knowledge service's reindex chain and unmounted-adapter refusal). Code and fixtures those PRs wrote against the 18 source shape follow the 19 shape here: `source.id` is `source.name`, `contentFields` is `content`, `reportUnmountedAdapters` names a source by its face, and the unmounted-adapter index test calls `reindexSource` now that `indexDocument` is gone. The second merge (at `c2bfa3ef7`) was forced by a conflict: `main` had gained its own protocol 19 conversion (`permission-view-all-fields-beside-record-bypass`), so the conversion registry, the migration registry template and the retired-key pin now carry both sets, sorted as the registry sorts them; `packages/spec/authorable-surface/ai.json` was merged three ways by hand so that this PR's removals and `main`'s new `ai/Skill:context` both stand; every generated spec surface was regenerated afterwards. The third merge (at `8b9b9d235`) was forced by #37723, which moved the ADR-0150 D3 rule into `packages/metadata-core/src/package-scoped-resolution.ts`: `core`'s file is taken from `main` (a re-export) and the `knowledge_source` row with its comment sits in `metadata-core`'s `PACKAGE_SCOPED_TYPES`; `default-changes.ts` keeps both protocol 19 entries (`main`'s `ai/AIModelConfig:provider` and this PR's `ai/KnowledgeSource:refresh`); the Studio menu placement pin takes `main`'s move of `position` and keeps this PR's row. The merge is its own commit and `packages/spec/authorable-defaults/ai.json` was regenerated in the next one (`737f44341`).
- **The declared default of `ai/KnowledgeSource:refresh`** sits under major 19 in `default-changes.ts` (no parsed value changes: the published JSON Schema now states the `{}` the parser always applied).
- **Enumeration pins found by CI, not by the first local pass.** The first head was verified on the packages the change edits. CI then failed on tests in packages it does not edit, each a list that counts metadata types or the platform administrator's capabilities: the owner-stamp boot fixture and the unbundled-type list (`packages/metadata`), the tier list (`packages/metadata-protocol`), the type-label counts (`packages/platform-objects`), four golden grant lists (`packages/plugins/plugin-security`), and the generated `zh-Hant` locale. Each gained the one entry; no product code changed for them. The suites of those packages and the workspace type check now run locally as well (see Verification).
- **Review round 1.** The contract review on `45ed21271` (comment 7206413701) read PASS with findings, and the seat ordered a rework (7206423476). This head answers it: authoring guards cover more doors and more of what a source reads (the package doors, the duplicate door, the fields `where` reads, the service lookup at the dispatcher and at MCP), the `content` member refuses the empty string, the changeset lists the twelve removed exports, and this body is corrected on the face collision and states the narrowing counts. The findings' detail is with the seat. Two nits are carried by cards the zone files under #37304 (ADR-0084 prose; tombstone wording for code-door registrants).
- **Existing tests edited outside the card's first surface** (claim amended by the zone, comment 7207505784 on #37304), each because a package door now reads the package for a caller without the capability:
  - `packages-publish-drafts-request-conformance.test.ts`: the real-protocol case's caller also holds `manage_knowledge_sources` (its engine is one nothing may touch; the case pins the protocol's own order). Assertions unchanged.
  - `packages-publish-drafts-probe-caller-context.test.ts`: the protocol double gains a `getMetaItemsPerPackage` stub beside its `getMetaItems` stub. Assertions unchanged.
  - `package-state-host-store.test.ts` (a kernel with no driver) and `domains/error-passthrough.test.ts` (a protocol double that throws from every member): the caller also holds `manage_knowledge_sources`. Assertions unchanged.
  - `packages-ensure-customization.test.ts`, "duplicate: 400 before a row is read": **the measure changes.** The door now reads the source package's knowledge sources to admit them before the copy runs, so the case counts the reads made inside `protocol.duplicatePackage` (still 0) instead of every engine read; it also asserts the copy was entered once.
- **Open PRs that will conflict with this one** (overlap-check on this head against 12 open PR heads; `main` itself merges cleanly): #37422 (the generated references and `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: whichever lands second re-measures the row), #37366 (`packages/spec/export-origins/ai.json`). Whichever of each pair lands second merges `main`.

## Verification

First files to read, by risk:
1. `packages/services/service-knowledge/src/knowledge-source-registry.ts`: the slot and face rules.
2. `packages/services/service-knowledge/src/knowledge-source-loader.ts`: what each metadata event does to an index.
3. `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts` (`META_TYPE_WRITE_CAPABILITIES`) and `packages/metadata-core/src/knowledge-source-save-admission.ts`: the two guards.
4. `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` (`refuseKnowledgeSourcePackageWrite`, `refuseDuplicatedKnowledgeSources`): the guards at the package doors.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-knowledge exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/__tests__/knowledge-source-registry.test.ts src/__tests__/knowledge-source-loader.test.ts`.

Head `cf128e59f` (review round 1). Verified so far on this head, locally, every heavy run under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`: build exit 0; `@objectstack/runtime` full suite exit 0 (657 files, 13676 passed, 25 skipped); `@objectstack/metadata-core` and `@objectstack/core` exit 0; `tsc --noEmit` on `packages/runtime` exit 0. Running now on the same head, and written here when they end: the other package suites, the workspace type check, the derived gates, the full dogfood battery and the ablations. CI on this head is in progress. The previous head's readings (`45ed21271`: 62 check runs green, 185 gates, the dogfood battery, six ablations) are in the os-dev report, comment 7206197293 on #37304.
